propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates compose-review-bot-1 container without draining in-flight reviews, killing the review mid-execution
the reconciler retry path (reconcile_loop) is unprotected from shutdown because it awaits review_and_vote outside the graceful shutdown queue, unlike webhook-queued reviews

during a landing burst with deploys arriving faster than reviews complete (~10 min), reviews are repeatedly killed before voting, causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock with no health signal indicating failure

the defer strategy defers deploys when in_flight > 0 (keyed to deferral episode, not target SHA) with a 1800s bound, avoiding both the lock contention of DRAIN and the insufficient safety of COALESCE alone
observability gap is closed by counting AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT tokens with a new paging alarm, ensuring a live-locked gate is no longer invisible to monitoring
